BPO Recruitment Solution
Empowering BPO Recruitment for Same-Day Hiring and Securing Top Talent
BPO recruitment has emerged as a lifeline for businesses seeking operational excellence and cost savings. Finding the right talent, cultural alignment, and seamless collaboration pose significant challenges.
Talview offers an
end-to-end, AI-powered hiring
and proctoring
solution
that is ideal for BPOs. You’ll save time screening, assessing, shortlisting, and interviewing hundreds and thousands of candidates, while engaging more candidates with our mobile-friendly candidate app.
Moreover, with our
Instahiring Methodology
, you’ll create a flexible,
completely digital hiring process designed to reduce time to hire, increase quality of hire, and lower cost of hire
How Talview Can Help You with BPO Recruitment
Hire With Confidence On The Same Day
With our automated workflows, complete entire hiring process under 4 hours, including skills evaluations, behavioral fitment, linguistic assessments, and interviews. Reduce drop-offs by hiring faster.
Eliminate Traditional Language Assessments
Evaluate spoken English proficiency without additional assessments. During an ongoing video interview, Talview Linguistic Insights extracts valuable information which helps assess a candidate's language proficiency in terms of grammar, listening comprehension skills, pronunciation, way of speech, and trainability.
Personality and Behavioral Insights for Unbiased Hiring
Talview's solution offers Personality and Behavioral Assessments, providing valuable insights into candidates' traits and characteristics. Talview Behavioral Insights helps you identify the right candidates who align with your company culture and values, helping you improve diversity and inclusion within your organization.
Volume Hiring With Ease
Traditional hiring methods are manual and time consuming.
Talview's end-to-end hiring platform, built to scale, eliminates errors and delays by automating time consuming bulk tasks such as resume screening, interview scheduling, and offer management. By automating repetitive tasks, you can concentrate on the important hiring aspects.
Improve Candidate Engagement and Experience
Our mobile-friendly candidate app allows candidates to easily take assessments, attend video interviews, and engage with the employer's brand via a wide range of channels including QR codes, text messages, Recruitment Chatbot, WhatsApp, and Facebook. Our intuitive platform is available across various devices including laptops, desktops, Android phones, Mac, iPads, or iPhones.
Overview of Talview’s BPO Recruitment Solution
Simplify your scheduling process and overcome common challenges recruiters face while managing multiple interviews. With
, candidates and hiring managers can effortlessly book interview slots with minimum effort required.
Linguistic Insights
Talview Linguistic Insights
(TLI) revolutionizes candidate assessments by harnessing AI, NLP, and machine learning technology. Evaluates grammar, listening skills, pronunciation, speech style, and trainability with precision. Aligned with the CEFR standard, TLI ensures accurate language proficiency assessment, eliminating the need for traditional evaluations.
Behavioral Assessment
Talview Behavioral Assessment
helps you find the best fit for your organization. It leverage psycholinguistics to analyze a candidate’s response and predict behavior, giving you more in-depth information than a regular interview.
